recipes.name: Mango Spinach Smoothie
instructions: Add all of the ingredients to a high-speed blender.
Blend on high until smooth. Pour into tall glasses or into bowls to sprinkle overtop your favourite toppings. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use a plant-based milk and yogurt that is fortified with calcium .
Storage Best to enjoy this smoothie immediately.
